title: Site Coverage and Multiple Pantry Programmes Held by One Client
content:
A client may hold an Office Pantry & Beverage Program programme at as many sites as it has, and there is no ceiling on the number held at once. Each programme is written against exactly one site, with its own standing list, delivery weekday and allowance.

## The rule

1. No ceiling stands on the number of pantry programmes one client holds at the same time.
2. A further pantry programme is not opened for a site that already carries an open pantry programme, so at most 1 open pantry programme stands against any one site.
3. A site's programme counts as open while it is proposed, active or paused, and counts as gone once it is closed.
4. Where a client wants a second pantry point on another floor of a site already under agreement, it is added to the existing programme as a second delivery point rather than opened separately.

## What settles whether a site already carries a programme

The question is settled before a further programme is drawn up, from Larkspur Table's own pantry programme records rather than from what the client says it holds. Records are matched on the client organisation together with the site: a pantry programme at another site of the same client, and a pantry programme at the same site held by a different client, are each outside the question. Where more than one programme stands recorded for one client and one site, the programmes are told apart by the first day of the proposed term and by the pantry tier written against them.

## The open states, tested one at a time

| Status standing against the site's existing programme | Does the site carry an open pantry programme |
| --- | --- |
| proposed | yes |
| active | yes |
| paused | yes |
| closed | no |

A site whose only earlier pantry programme stands closed therefore carries no open programme. A site whose programme stands paused, and a site whose programme has been drawn up as a proposal and not yet signed, each carry an open programme, since paused and proposed are both open states.
